edges.reason: transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
transferFrom enforces require(ensure(_from,_to,_value)) whitelist gate
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted senders
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked -= and += instead of SafeMath
batchSend subtracts balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total and adds balanceOf[_to] += _value with unchecked arithmetic
batchSend relies on local total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] tracking per-address transfers
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of allowed sales
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum
condition reads _minSale to enforce minimum transfer amount
condition reads _maxSale to enforce maximum transfer amount
ensure reads owner to auto-approve owner as _from or _to
ensure reads canSale[_from] to bypass sale restrictions for whitelisted addresses
ensure reads tradeAddress to bypass the condition() check
ensure compares _from against the constant UNI router address
delegate executes a.delegatecall(b), letting an attacker-controlled address run code with this contract's storage
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall
init sets _minSale from the token parameter
init sets _maxSale from the maxToken parameter
init sets _saleNum controlling how many sales are allowed
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner
constructor sets owner = msg.sender
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply
constructor grants maximum allowance to the UNI router address
constructor sets totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals)
msg.sender is checked against _from and consumes allowance[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom
msg.sender must equal owner to pass the delegate() guard
msg.sender must equal owner to pass the init() guard
msg.sender must equal owner to pass the batchSend() guard
msg.sender must equal owner to pass the setTradeAddress() guard
transfer uses msg.sender as the _from account in transferFrom
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner
callOptionalReturn performs the raw address(token).call(data) external interaction

_to parameter is the recipient credited in transferFrom
_value parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom
local total drives the unchecked balance subtraction in batchSend

_tos array supplies recipients in batchSend
_value parameter is credited per recipient in batchSend

bytes b is the delegatecall calldata in delegate
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum by init

maxToken parameter is multiplied by 10**decimals to set _maxSale in init
